prompt: Audit and clean Pipedrive CRM data by exporting paginated leads and related records, then bulk-normalizing titles, organization names, duplicate organizations, deal and lead titles, lead labels, and custom-field data.

results.use_case: Audit and clean Pipedrive CRM data by exporting paginated leads and related records, then bulk-normalizing titles, organization names, duplicate organizations, deal and lead titles, lead labels, and custom-field data.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if organization IDs are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Identify likely duplicate organizations using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS (query for near-matches) or PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS (compile candidate list).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Validate each candidate pair using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION (confirm same entity) and decide the survivor vs losing organization.
[Required] [Step]: Build a dry-run merge map (losing → survivor) from PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION results and get explicit approval before any irreversible writes.
[Required] [Step]: Merge the losing organization into the survivor using PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_ORGANIZATIONS (ensure survivor remains).
[Optional (if primary merge fails)] [Fallback]: Retry the same pair using PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_TWO_ORGANIZATIONS (single-pair recovery).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Spot-check the surviving organization using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION (confirm key fields/links consolidated).
[Optional (after bulk cleanup)] [Next Step]: Re-scan using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS or PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS (confirm duplicates no longer appear).
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_ORGANIZATIONS] Response fields may be nested; don’t assume a flat success/id payload.
[PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_ORGANIZATIONS] Merge direction is easy to invert; ensure the losing id is merged into merge_with_id (the survivor).
[PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS] Results can include near-matches; always confirm via PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION before merging.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS] Pagination is required (often ~500 records/page); missing pages can hide duplicates.
[PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_ORGANIZATIONS] Bulk dedup runs need a checkpointed list of completed merges to avoid reprocessing pairs.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_ORGANIZATIONS.description: Tool to merge two organizations in Pipedrive. Use when you need to consolidate two organizations into one. The organization specified by 'id' will be merged into the organization specified by 'merge_with_id', and the first organization will be removed while the second one will remain with all consolidated data.

id.description: The ID of the organization that will be merged and removed from the account

merge_with_id.description: The ID of the organization that will remain in the account and receive the merged data. This organization takes priority in conflict scenarios.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION.description: Tool to get details of a specific organization in Pipedrive. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about an organization by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the organization to retrieve

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated list of custom field keys to include (maximum 15 keys). Use this parameter for faster results and smaller responses when only specific custom fields are needed.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response. Acceptable values: next_activity_id, last_activity_id, open_deals_count, related_open_deals_count, closed_deals_count, related_closed_deals_count, email_messages_count, people_count, activities_count, done_activities_count, undone_activities_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count, won_deals_count, related_won_deals_count, lost_deals_count, related_lost_deals_count

PIPEDRIVE_MERGE_TWO_ORGANIZATIONS.description: Merges an organization with another organization. For more information, see the tutorial for merging two organizations.

merge_with_id.description: The ID of the organization that the organization will be merged with
